# NDMAPSpinChain

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/NDMAPSpinChain`

```text
usage : 

  -h, --help : display this help
  -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
  --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
  --iter-max : maximum number of lanczos iteration (including resume run) (default value = 3000)
  -i, --nbr-iter : number of lanczos iteration (for the current run) (default value = 10)
  --nbr-spin : number of spins (default value = 8)
  -n, --nbr-eigen : number of eigenvalues (default value = 1)
  -d, --anisotropy-constant : value of the anisotropy constant (default value = 0)
  -e, --inplane-anisotropy-constant : value of the in-plane anisotropy constant (default value = 0)
  -a, --perpendicular-bfield : value of b field in the direction perpendicular to the chain (default value = 0)
  -z, --parallel-bfield : value of b field in the direction parallel to the chain (default value = 0)
  -m, --memory : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast multiplication (in Mbytes) (default value = 500)
  --fixed-momentum : evaluate for one given momentum value
  --momentum : momentum value if fixed-momentum is fixed to true (default value = 0)
  --reorthogonalize : use reorthogonalized version of the lanczos algorithm
  --nbr-vector : maximum number of vector in RAM during Lanczos iteration (default value = 10)
  --disk : enable disk resume capabilities
  --resume : resume from disk datas
```
